scope: Per-row and entire measured-matrix dominance under listed cost dimensions; semantic admissibility is a separate requirement. These isolated programs are not whole applications.
definition: candidate dominates iff it is no worse in every listed dimension and strictly better in at least one; matrix dominance requires this over all rows.
production_default: published 0.31 plus independently measured low-mask slice #41; no additional production transformation selected
limitations: Finite measured inputs only; no workload weighting or global optimality
The branching probes embed each selected input in their own artifact; compare paired rows, not a production threshold
Borrowing and source CSE win isolated costs but remain semantically unadmitted
Static stack quantities and observed per-VM stack peaks are distinct
Raw input integers, including u64::MAX, remain authoritative in original reports

input.scope: two exact compressed instructions inside unchanged ELF layout; independent checker deliberately rejects mixed width
